scope: Internal method review of the completed policy-composition transfer trial; reviewed report, manifest, reviewed plans, event journal, trial code, tests, and internal prose review. This review is authored by the plan-repair author and is not a fully independent external review.
verdict: FAIL: the composed workflow did not meet the all-cases policy-correctness gate, although the transfer result isolates a confidence-gating failure mode rather than establishing four model-semantic top-1 errors.

findings.detail: The frozen transfer contained 12 cases across cobalt-market, maple-mobility, and quartz-care with three reviewed plans. All 6 Luna episodes completed. The journal contains 12 Jev responses and 6 OpenAI responses with zero api.error events. Report and raw-event totals agree: Jev 22,177 input and 2,184 output tokens; OpenAI 545,951 input, 5,706 output, 440,576 cached input, and 758 reasoning-output tokens. Baseline episode time was 111.229564 seconds with 25 tool calls and 12 source reads; composed episode time was 116.104778 seconds with 24 tool calls and 12 source reads. Jev workflow time summed to 2.493407 seconds.

The report summary is baseline 12/12, broad same-response outcome 12/12, and composed gated outcome 8/12. Composed had 2 missed required notifications and 0 false business notifications; the other 2 failures were unnecessary investigations on quiet cases. This is a fresh transfer result, not the prior legacy 12/12 fixture result.

In the four composed deviations, the selected atomic top-1 answers were aligned with the transfer evidence but fell below the SUPPORT_FLOOR of 0.70. Cobalt regional_comparable selected true with probability 0.63 and was mapped to unknown, producing insufficient_data under the frozen label instead of the regional OR notification; the corrected prose review finds that case's comparability evidence ambiguous, so this is not a definite Cobalt business error. Maple exception_conflict selected false with probabilities 0.57, 0.62, and 0.59 on three no-claim cases; each was mapped to unknown, producing investigate instead of the applicable notify/ignore route. Those three Maple errors remain clear. The missing-cancellation case remained correct because required_metrics_available=false was handled by the earlier explicit data-gap rule.

The 0.70 floor is a valid safety-gating policy that turns low-support answers into abstention; it is not evidence that the underlying model answer is false. Lowering or ignoring the threshold post hoc would not repair semantic correctness and would change the safety policy. The transfer establishes a calibration/abstention interaction requiring a separately designed policy experiment, not a threshold-based success claim.

Each composed case sends the semantic checks and overall_outcome question in one Jev request with the same policy, evidence, compiled plan, and code-computed numeric checks. broad_outcome is another choice from that same response, not an independent Jev call or independent model. Therefore broad 12/12 cannot be interpreted as an independent replication of narrow composition.

The corrected independent prose review found the first Cobalt case ambiguous: f1 states the same weekly total population and f4 states the same settled-order definition, but those facts may not literally establish comparable regional populations. The corrected review accepts both candidate readings and ties. Frozen primary labels remain 12/12 baseline, 12/12 broad, and 8/12 composed; excluding that disputed case yields 11/11 baseline, 11/11 broad, and 8/11 composed. This is a research transparency sensitivity, not a primary-label rescore, and the Cobalt case must not be presented as a definite false data-gap judgment.

Both baseline and composed writers received the new transfer policy, compiled plan, public facts, and exact code-computed numeric checks. Only the composed writer received the authoritative workflow result. The trial therefore tests plan-mediated composition and writer adherence, but not a separate latency or error comparison between independently executed broad and narrow Jev calls.

The corrected independent prose review assessed baseline versus composed narratives only; it marked all 12 baseline narratives usable and 8/12 composed narratives usable. The first Cobalt case was accepted for both candidates with a tie because its regional-comparability evidence is ambiguous. A fourth composed prose failure, on the missing-cancellation case, had the correct structured insufficient_data/data-owner result but added an unsupported exception caveat. There was no separate broad-Jev writer arm: broad_outcome was not passed to the writer. The prose review is internal AI review, not human preference measurement or external peer review; the initial review is archived separately.

The reviewed plans were directly repaired before this transfer and validated with abstract truth-vector tests. This was not raw unattended first-shot onboarding. The transfer uses synthetic facts, code-computed metrics, one sample per case, bounded local transport, and no production side effects; it does not prove production reliability, human toil savings, or enterprise generalization.

admissible_claims: On this frozen 12-case transfer, baseline Luna and the same-response broad Jev outcome both scored 12/12, while the composed confidence-gated workflow scored 8/12.

Under the frozen labels, the composed workflow had two missed required notifications and unnecessarily investigated two quiet cases, with no false business notifications in this sample; one of the two frozen missed-notification labels is the disputed first Cobalt case and is not a definite business error.

The observed composed deviations are consistent with confidence gating: four selected atomic top-1 answers were below the 0.70 support floor and became unknown; the three Maple deviations are clear, while the first Cobalt label is semantically ambiguous.
Excluding the disputed first Cobalt case as a sensitivity analysis leaves baseline and broad at 11/11 and composed at 8/11; this does not replace the frozen primary result.
The reviewed plans and exact numeric checks were frozen before runtime case processing, and all 12 Jev calls completed without provider errors.
rejected_claims: Do not claim composed semantic correctness, Jev semantic reliability, or a repaired benchmark from the 8/12 result.
Do not claim broad 12/12 is an independent control or independent Jev replication; broad and narrow judgments shared one Jev request.
Do not claim that lowering, removing, or post-hoc ignoring the 0.70 confidence floor fixes the workflow.
Do not claim the first Cobalt transfer case proves a definite regional-comparability data gap or definite missed business alert; the corrected prose review accepts both readings and ties.
Do not compare this transfer 12/12 baseline to the prior legacy 12/12 result as if they were the same fixture or a production control.
Do not claim end-to-end broad-Jev prose quality, human preference, human hours saved, cost savings, or production readiness from this artifact.
